name: Adobe Firefly
title: firefly.adobe.com
shortDescription: Adobe Firefly is a cutting-edge creative tool designed for artists, designers, and content creators. It leverages AI to generate high-quality images, videos, and SVGs from text descriptions. Users can start with an image and generate videos, remix images on a board, or create using 3D shapes. An example use case is a graphic designer generating promotional materials quickly without starting from scratch.
cons: Potential learning curve for new users
